summary: Prime-level Eisenstein arithmetic of modular Jacobians, from integral weight-two congruences and the cuspidal class through component groups, finite-flat Galois modules, local Hecke rings, Ogg’s rational torsion theorem and descent. The Eisenstein quotient is an abelian variety and its rational points are the image of the cuspidal subgroup. The final prime-torsion classification includes all primes, with a separate level-13 descent.
